lyrics.ja: いつからだろう 夢を語るのが
lyrics.romaji: Itsu kara darou yume wo kataru no ga
lyrics.en: When did it start, that speaking of dreams
lyrics.zh: 是從什麼時候開始呢 訴說夢想這件事

lyrics.ja: 少し怖くなったのは
lyrics.romaji: Sukoshi kowaku natta no wa
lyrics.en: Became a little frightening?
lyrics.zh: 變得有些令人害怕了呢

lyrics.ja: いつからだろう 俯く癖がついて
lyrics.romaji: Itsu kara darou utsumuku kuse ga tsuite
lyrics.en: When did it start, that I developed a habit of looking down
lyrics.zh: 是從什麼時候開始呢 養成了低頭的習慣

lyrics.ja: 空を見上げなくなったのは
lyrics.romaji: Sora wo miagenaku natta no wa
lyrics.en: And stopped looking up at the sky?
lyrics.zh: 變得不再仰望天空了呢

lyrics.ja: 誰かの言葉に傷ついて
lyrics.romaji: Dareka no kotoba ni kizutsuite
lyrics.en: Hurt by someone's words,
lyrics.zh: 被某人的話語所傷害

lyrics.ja: 立ち止まってしまった日も
lyrics.romaji: Tachidomatte shimatta hi mo
lyrics.en: Even on days I stopped in my tracks.
lyrics.zh: 甚至在停下腳步的那天也是

lyrics.ja: 羽を手にして 飛び立つんだ
lyrics.romaji: Hane wo te ni shite tobitatsu n da
lyrics.en: With wings in hand, I'll take flight
lyrics.zh: 緊握雙翼 展翅高飛吧

lyrics.ja: まだ見ぬ世界へ
lyrics.romaji: Mada minu sekai e
lyrics.en: To a world yet unseen.
lyrics.zh: 飛向那未曾見過的世界

lyrics.ja: 羽を手にして 飛び立つんだ
lyrics.romaji: Hane wo te ni shite tobitatsu n da
lyrics.en: With wings in hand, I'll take flight
lyrics.zh: 緊握雙翼 展翅高飛吧

lyrics.ja: 未来を信じて
lyrics.romaji: Mirai wo shinjite
lyrics.en: Believing in the future.
lyrics.zh: 堅信著未來

lyrics.ja: いつからだろう 笑顔の裏に隠した
lyrics.romaji: Itsu kara darou egao no ura ni kakushita
lyrics.en: When did it start, that hidden behind my smile
lyrics.zh: 是從什麼時候開始呢 藏在笑容背後

lyrics.ja: 涙が増えていったのは
lyrics.romaji: Namida ga fuete itta no wa
lyrics.en: My tears began to increase?
lyrics.zh: 淚水變得越來越多了呢

lyrics.ja: いつからだろう 諦めることに慣れて
lyrics.romaji: Itsu kara darou akirameru koto ni narete
lyrics.en: When did it start, that I got used to giving up
lyrics.zh: 是從什麼時候開始呢 習慣了放棄

lyrics.ja: 強がってしまったのは
lyrics.romaji: Tsuyogatte shimatta no wa
lyrics.en: And started to act tough?
lyrics.zh: 變得逞強了呢

lyrics.ja: 誰かの優しさに触れて
lyrics.romaji: Dareka no yasashisa ni furete
lyrics.en: Touched by someone's kindness,
lyrics.zh: 觸碰到某人的溫柔

lyrics.ja: また歩き出せた日も
lyrics.romaji: Mata arukidaseta hi mo
lyrics.en: Even on days I could start walking again.
lyrics.zh: 甚至在再次邁出腳步的那天也是

lyrics.ja: 何度でも立ち上がれるさ
lyrics.romaji: Nando demo tachiagareru sa
lyrics.en: I can stand up again, no matter how many times.
lyrics.zh: 無論多少次都能再次站起來

lyrics.ja: 君とならどこまでも行ける
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to nara doko made mo ikeru
lyrics.en: With you, I can go anywhere.
lyrics.zh: 只要有你 就能走到任何地方

lyrics.ja: 羽を手にして 飛び立つんだ
lyrics.romaji: Hane wo te ni shite tobitatsu n da
lyrics.en: With wings in hand, I'll take flight
lyrics.zh: 緊握雙翼 展翅高飛吧

lyrics.ja: まだ見ぬ世界へ
lyrics.romaji: Mada minu sekai e
lyrics.en: To a world yet unseen.
lyrics.zh: 飛向那未曾見過的世界

lyrics.ja: 羽を手にして 飛び立つんだ
lyrics.romaji: Hane wo te ni shite tobitatsu n da
lyrics.en: With wings in hand, I'll take flight
lyrics.zh: 緊握雙翼 展翅高飛吧

lyrics.ja: 未来を信じて
lyrics.romaji: Mirai wo shinjite
lyrics.en: Believing in the future.
lyrics.zh: 堅信著未來
